acceptanceCriteria: internal/dogfoodflow exposes one bounded git reader with a documented cap and overflow outcome, used by ocm_coverage.go and flow.git's callers
a test drives output past the cap and observes the documented NOT_OBSERVED/refusal outcome without unbounded growth
unbounded-readers-check and the dogfoodflow package tests stay green
body: Observed 2026-10-13 in lane V1-1345 (PR beamfall/corvint#862, commit 33e01d0a1). Codex review flagged that the new OCM coverage reader called git diff / git grep through an unbounded reader. The fix capped it at 16 MiB (overflow prints NOT_OBSERVED), but the cap had to live in internal/dogfoodflow/ocm_coverage.go because flow.git in internal/dogfoodflow/flow.go buffers git output with no limit and flow.go was outside that lane's scope. Version: corvint at origin/main 523fa4ce6 + the lane. Expected: one shared capped git reader in flow.go (or a bounded helper beside it) that existing callers and new readers use, with the overflow outcome spelled once. Actual: a second copy in ocm_coverage.go; flow.git remains unbounded for its current callers. Friction, not a confirmed defect: no reported overflow in practice.
title: dogfoodflow: flow.git buffers git output with no limit, so every new reader duplicates a capped variant
